prompt_ir.subject: CHAR-LIN with PROP-RED-ENVELOPE
prompt_ir.action: opens envelope, reads, freezes, ends holding it at chest
prompt_ir.lighting: cool window-left key plus warm printer practical
prompt_ir.temporal_constraints: one action chain; no second person

prompts.rendered_prompt: CHAR-LIN alone in LOC-COPY-ROOM at night, medium wide locked camera. She opens PROP-RED-ENVELOPE, reads one line, and freezes. Cool window-left key, warm printer practical, stable black bob and navy cardigan. End with envelope held at chest. No other person, no camera movement, no text mutation.

prompt_ir.subject: CHAR-LIN hand and PROP-RED-ENVELOPE
prompt_ir.action: slides envelope under printer tray and starts printer
prompt_ir.lighting: warm printer practical with stable cool fill
prompt_ir.temporal_constraints: one hand action; end with one red corner visible

prompts.rendered_prompt: Close insert in LOC-COPY-ROOM. CHAR-LIN slides PROP-RED-ENVELOPE beneath the printer output tray and starts the printer. Locked close shot, one hand action only, maintain envelope orientation and warm printer practical. End with one red corner visible. No extra fingers, no new paper, no camera movement.

prompt_ir.subject: CHAR-LIN and CHAR-BO
prompt_ir.action: BO enters from right and stops; LIN blocks printer
prompt_ir.lighting: stable cool window-left key and warm printer practical
prompt_ir.temporal_constraints: entrance then stop; no simultaneous walking and talking

prompts.rendered_prompt: CHAR-BO enters LOC-COPY-ROOM from screen right and stops beside the door; CHAR-LIN remains screen left blocking the printer. Locked two-shot with stable eyeline, cool window-left key and warm printer practical. BO asks for the report while LIN keeps one hand on the tray. End with both facing each other. No simultaneous walking and talking.

prompt_ir.subject: CHAR-LIN, CHAR-BO and red envelope corner
prompt_ir.action: LIN taps printer; BO shifts gaze to red corner; LIN notices

prompts.rendered_prompt: Medium two-shot in LOC-COPY-ROOM. CHAR-LIN taps the printer as a delay tactic while CHAR-BO watches her hand, then shifts attention to the red corner under the tray. One slow lateral reveal only, stable identities and screen direction. End with BO looking at the corner and LIN noticing his gaze.

prompt_ir.subject: printer tray and PROP-RED-ENVELOPE
prompt_ir.action: printer stops and envelope slides fully into view
prompt_ir.lighting: printer practical fades while cool window light remains

prompts.rendered_prompt: Insert on the printer output tray. The printer stops during a brief power dip; PROP-RED-ENVELOPE slides fully into view. Locked close shot, no hands, cool room falls darker while warm practical fades. End with envelope fully visible and unchanged.

prompt_ir.subject: CHAR-BO, PROP-BO-RESIGNATION and PROP-RED-ENVELOPE
prompt_ir.action: BO places resignation card beside envelope and withdraws hand
prompt_ir.temporal_constraints: one hand action; dialogue recorded separately

prompts.rendered_prompt: Single on CHAR-BO, medium close-up. He removes a plain resignation card from his jacket, places it beside PROP-RED-ENVELOPE, and says he signed the false report. Locked camera, one hand action, stable charcoal jacket. End with his hand withdrawn and card beside envelope.

prompt_ir.subject: CHAR-LIN, resignation card, access badge and red envelope
prompt_ir.action: LIN removes card and replaces it with her badge

prompts.rendered_prompt: Single on CHAR-LIN, medium close-up. She absorbs the confession, removes CHAR-BO resignation card from PROP-RED-ENVELOPE, and replaces it with her own silver access badge. Locked camera, deliberate one hand action, no dialogue. End with badge inside the open envelope and her face resolved.

prompt_ir.subject: CHAR-LIN, CHAR-BO and sealed red envelope
prompt_ir.action: LIN deposits envelope; BO steps aside

prompts.rendered_prompt: Two-shot facing the audit slot in LOC-COPY-ROOM. CHAR-LIN seals PROP-RED-ENVELOPE and pushes it into the audit slot; CHAR-BO steps aside instead of stopping her. Slow push-in only after the envelope leaves her hand. End on the empty space between them, stable screen direction and lighting.
